title: चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 14 · Bhima and Krishna urge action

summary.en: Yudhishthira, fearing the task, thinks of giving up the sacrifice. Bhima argues that effort guided by policy wins, and Krishna proposes that he, Bhima and Arjuna together can overcome Jarasandha.
summary.kn: ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆದರಿದ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನು ಯಜ್ಞ ಬಿಡಲು ಯೋಚಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ನೀತಿಯಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಜಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಭೀಮನು ವಾದಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ತಾನು, ಭೀಮ, ಅರ್ಜುನ ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಜರಾಸಂಧನನ್ನು ಜಯಿಸಬಹುದು ಎಂದು ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: कार्य से डरकर युधिष्ठिर यज्ञ छोड़ने का विचार करते हैं। भीम तर्क देते हैं कि नीति से युक्त प्रयत्न सफल होता है, और श्रीकृष्ण प्रस्ताव करते हैं कि वे, भीम और अर्जुन मिलकर जरासन्ध को जीत सकते हैं।
summary.te: ఆ కార్యానికి భయపడిన యుధిష్ఠిరుడు యజ్ఞం విరమించాలని ఆలోచిస్తాడు. నీతితో కూడిన ప్రయత్నమే జయిస్తుందని భీముడు వాదిస్తాడు; తాను, భీముడు, అర్జునుడు కలిసి జరాసంధుని జయించగలమని శ్రీకృష్ణుడు సూచిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: பணிக்கு அஞ்சிய யுதிஷ்டிரர் யாகத்தைக் கைவிட நினைக்கிறார். நீதியுடன் கூடிய முயற்சியே வெல்லும் என்று பீமன் வாதிட, தாமும் பீமனும் அர்ஜுனனும் சேர்ந்து ஜராஸந்தனை வெல்லலாம் என்று ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் யோசனை சொல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: ദൗത്യത്തെ ഭയന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ യജ്ഞം ഉപേക്ഷിക്കാൻ ചിന്തിക്കുന്നു. ബുദ്ധിയാൽ നയിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന പരിശ്രമം വിജയിക്കുമെന്ന് ഭീമൻ വാദിക്കുന്നു; താനും ഭീമനും അർജുനനും ചേർന്ന് ജരാസന്ധനെ കീഴടക്കാമെന്ന് കൃഷ്ണൻ നിർദേശിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 2.14; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Apr 19 2006

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
उक्तं त्वया बुद्धिमता यन्नान्यो वक्तुमर्हति ।
संशयानां हि निर्मोक्ता त्वन्नान्यो विद्यते भुवि ॥

meaning.en: You have spoken wisely, as no one else could; there is no one on earth but you who can free us from doubts.

verses.text:
गृहे गृहे हि राजानः स्वस्य स्वस्य प्रियंकराः ।
न च साम्राज्यमाप्तास्ते सम्राट्शब्दो हि कृत्स्नभाक् ॥

meaning.en: In house after house the kings each look to their own interests; none of them has attained imperial rank, for the word "emperor" covers the whole.

verses.text:
कथं परानुभावज्ञः स्वं प्रशंसितुमर्हति ।
परेण समवेतस्तु यः प्रशस्तः स पूज्यते ॥

meaning.en: How can one who knows the strength of others praise himself? One who is praised by others who agree with him is truly honored.

verses.text:
विशाला बहुला भूमिर्बहुरत्नसमाचिता ।
दूरं गत्वा विजानाति श्रेयो वृष्णिकुलोद्वह ॥

meaning.en: The earth is wide and rich, heaped with many jewels; one who goes far afield learns what is best, O bearer of the Vrishni line.

verses.text:
शममेव परं मन्ये न तु मोक्षाद्भवेच्छमः ।
आरम्भे पारमेष्ठ्यं तु न प्राप्यमिति मे मतिः ॥

meaning.en: I think peace alone is best, but peace does not come from release; and I think that supreme sovereignty is not to be had by merely beginning.

verses.text:
एवमेवाभिजानन्ति कुले जाता मनस्विनः ।
कश्चित्कदाचिदेतेषां भवेच्छ्रेष्ठो जनार्दन ॥

meaning.en: Thoughtful men born in noble families know this too: only one of them, Janardana, may someday be the best.

verses.text: भीम उवाच

meaning.en: Bhima said:

verses.text:
अनारम्भपरो राजा वल्मीक इव सीदति ।
दुर्बलश्चानुपायेन बलिनं योऽधितिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: A king who does not undertake anything sinks like an anthill, as does a weak man who attacks a strong one without means.

verses.text:
अतन्द्रितस्तु प्रायेण दुर्बलो बलिनं रिपुम् ।
जयेत्सम्यङ्नयो राजन्नीत्यार्थानात्मनो हितान् ॥

meaning.en: But a weak man, if alert, can mostly conquer a strong enemy, O king; sound policy gains for him the aims that profit him.

verses.text:
कृष्णे नयो मयि बलं जयः पार्थे धनंजये ।
मागधं साधयिष्यामो वयं त्रय इवाग्नयः ॥

meaning.en: Krishna has the policy, I have the strength, and Partha Dhananjaya has victory; the three of us will bring down the Magadha king like three sacred fires.

verses.text: कृष्ण उवाच

meaning.en: Krishna said:

verses.text:
आदत्तेऽर्थपरो बालो नानुबन्धमवेक्षते ।
तस्मादरिं न मृष्यन्ति बालमर्थपरायणम् ॥

meaning.en: A child, intent on gain, grasps at it and does not look to the consequence; therefore enemies do not tolerate a child bent on gain.

verses.text:
हित्वा करान्यौवनाश्वः पालनाच्च भगीरथः ।
कार्तवीर्यस्तपोयोगाद्बलात्तु भरतो विभुः ।
ऋद्ध्या मरुत्तस्तान्पञ्च सम्राज इति शुश्रुमः ॥

meaning.en: We have heard of five who became emperors: Yauvanashva, by giving up taxes; Bhagiratha, by protecting his people; Kartavirya, by the power of austerity; the mighty Bharata, by force; and Marutta, by prosperity.

verses.text:
निग्राह्यलक्षणं प्राप्तो धर्मार्थनयलक्षणैः ।
बार्हद्रथो जरासंधस्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Know, bull of the Bharatas, that Jarasandha, son of Brihadratha, has shown the marks of one who must be put down, by the signs of dharma, wealth and policy.

verses.text:
न चैनमनुरुध्यन्ते कुलान्येकशतं नृपाः ।
तस्मादेतद्बलादेव साम्राज्यं कुरुतेऽद्य सः ॥

meaning.en: The hundred and one royal families do not follow him willingly; therefore he holds imperial power now by force alone.

verses.text:
रत्नभाजो हि राजानो जरासंधमुपासते ।
न च तुष्यति तेनापि बाल्यादनयमास्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Kings who hold jewels serve Jarasandha, yet he is not content even with that, and in his childish folly follows the wrong policy.

verses.text:
मूर्धाभिषिक्तं नृपतिं प्रधानपुरुषं बलात् ।
आदत्ते न च नो दृष्टोऽभागः पुरुषतः क्वचित् ॥

meaning.en: He takes by force a consecrated king, a leading man, and in no case have we seen anyone left out of his share by him.

verses.text:
एवं सर्वान्वशे चक्रे जरासंधः शतावरान् ।
तं दुर्बलतरो राजा कथं पार्थ उपैष्यति ॥

meaning.en: In this way Jarasandha has brought under his sway the hundred lesser kings; how can a weaker king, Partha, approach him?

verses.text:
प्रोक्षितानां प्रमृष्टानां राज्ञां पशुपतेर्गृहे ।
पशूनामिव का प्रीतिर्जीविते भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: What joy is there in life, bull of the Bharatas, for kings who have been sprinkled and cleansed in the house of the lord of beasts, like animals for sacrifice?

verses.text:
क्षत्रियः शस्त्रमरणो यदा भवति सत्कृतः ।
ननु स्म मागधं सर्वे प्रतिबाधेम यद्वयम् ॥

meaning.en: When a Kshatriya whose death is by weapon is honored, should not all of us hold back the Magadha king?

verses.text:
षडशीतिः समानीताः शेषा राजंश्चतुर्दश ।
जरासंधेन राजानस्ततः क्रूरं प्रपत्स्यते ॥

meaning.en: Eighty-six have been brought together, and fourteen are left, O king; when Jarasandha has them all, he will do the cruel deed.

verses.text:
प्राप्नुयात्स यशो दीप्तं तत्र यो विघ्नमाचरेत् ।
जयेद्यश्च जरासंधं स सम्राण्नियतं भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: Whoever hinders him there will win shining glory, and whoever defeats Jarasandha will surely be emperor.
